name: Wanted: ORCS!
label: Quest
description: Wanted: ORCS!: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: By order of Corporal Noreg Stormpike, all able bodied soldiers of Stormpike are required to slay any opposing orcs that they meet upon the field of battle.
Soldiers are required to remove a tusk or tooth from the maw of the enemy and present said tooth as proof of their accomplishment.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You need a clip to pull the teeth out?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Good, friend. I expect the little mice.
